clauses.text: 1. Purpose

source_location.excerpt: 1. Purpose

clauses.text: This Billing Schedule Agreement (“Agreement”) outlines the terms, timelines, and procedures for invoicing and payments between Primevolta Hardware Solutions (“Vendor”) and FinSecure Services (“Client”). This Agreement aims to ensure timely obligation tracking, prevent revenue leakage, and align invoices with delivered goods and services.

source_location.excerpt: This Billing Schedule Agreement (“Agreement”) outlines the terms, timelines, and procedures for invoicing and payments between Primevolta Hardware Solutions (“Vendor”) and FinSecure Services (“Client”). This Agreement aims to ensure timely obligation tracking, prevent revenue leakage, and align invoices with delivered goods and services.

clauses.text: 2. Scope

source_location.excerpt: 2. Scope

clauses.text: This Agreement covers all hardware products supplied by the Vendor to the Client, including but not limited to networking devices, servers, storage systems, and electronic peripherals. It applies to purchase orders issued by the Client and accepted by the Vendor.

source_location.excerpt: This Agreement covers all hardware products supplied by the Vendor to the Client, including but not limited to networking devices, servers, storage systems, and electronic peripherals. It applies to purchase orders issued by the Client and accepted by the Vendor.
